This records cofkit's current PairIJ construction rather than claiming every UFF implementation uses the same export convention.
Backend element coverage is a mechanical parameter/typing boundary, not a validation claim for every coordination environment.
The bundled Open Babel table uses the legacy type label Lw6+3 for lawrencium; Lr is not claimed as supported by the current typing path.

parameter_source.description: Paper-backed standard DREIDING Tables I-II with UFF substitutions for Cu, Ni, and Mg (elements outside the DREIDING paper coverage).

citations.title: DREIDING: A Generic Force Field for Molecular Simulations
UFF, a Full Periodic Table Force Field for Molecular Mechanics and Molecular Dynamics Simulations
citations.authors: Rappe, Casewit, Colwell, Goddard, and Skiff

artifacts.provenance: cofkit's embedded DREIDING parameter table and element representatives.

atom_typing.implementation: Open Babel UFF atom types mapped to cofkit's DREIDING types over the explicit periodic CIF bond graph
notes: This is a bounded mapping, not a general DREIDING atom typer.

atom_typing.implementation: cofkit's bounded element-to-DREIDING-type map for rigid RASPA frameworks
notes: Only the explicitly registered backend elements are accepted; hybridization-dependent DREIDING typing is not performed.
DREIDING does not prescribe partial charges; input-CIF and EQeq charges are separate cofkit workflow choices.

hydrogen_bonding.convention: DREIDING Table V 12-10 donor-acceptor term (hbond/dreiding/lj), Rhb 2.75 A, cos^4(theta_DHA)
hydrogen_bonding.opt_out: cofkit calculate lammps-optimize / hybrid-mdmc and cofkit validate optimize accept --no-dreiding-hbond

notes: Hydrogen-bond terms are exported for the LAMMPS backend per DREIDING Table V (default on, opt-out via --no-dreiding-hbond); the RASPA backend has no hydrogen-bond term.
Cu, Ni, and Mg use UFF parameter substitutions (Rappe et al. 1992, DOI 10.1021/ja00051a040) because those elements are outside the DREIDING paper coverage.
No COF linkage family has yet completed a force-field-specific validation suite.

license.notes: Parameter values are scientific facts transcribed and verified against the published papers (10.1021/j100389a010, 10.1021/ja00051a040); the implementation is original cofkit code and the earlier heuristic seed carryover values have been fully replaced.

notes: The registry describes cofkit's implemented subset and deviations, not all published DREIDING variants.
